task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement 7 steps of a discrete-time quantum walk on a cycle of 0 nodes in Qiskit (position register + coin qubit, increment/decrement circuits), and print the final position distribution showing ballistic spread. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
